L71@P3: 1 Preface 前言
L72@P3: This specification describes the type, dimension, performance, technical characteristics, warnings and
L73@P3: cautions of the cylindrical lithium-ion rechargeable cell. The specification only applies to N21700CD-53E cell
L74@P3: supplied by Zhengzhou BAK Battery Co., Ltd.
L75@P3: 本标准描述了圆柱型锂离子电芯的外型、尺寸、特性、技术要求及注意事项。本标准适用于郑州比克
L76@P3: 电池有限公司生产的圆柱型 N21700CD-53E 锂离子电芯。
L77@P3: 2 Definition 定义
L78@P3: 2.1 Standard charge method 标准充电方式
L79@P3: At 25 ± 2 ℃, the cell is charged to 4.20 V at constant current of 0.5C (2575 mA), then charged at constant
L80@P3: voltage of 4.20 V until the current is ≤ 0.01C (52 mA) followed by resting for 5 min.
L81@P3: 在25 ± 2 ℃下，电芯以0.5C (2575 mA)恒流充电至4.20 V后，以4.20 V恒压充电至电流小于等于0.01C
L82@P3: (52 mA)，静置 5 min。
L83@P3: 2.2 Standard discharge method 标准放电方式
L84@P3: Under 25 ± 2 ℃, the cell is discharged to 2.50 V at a constant current of 0.2C (1030 mA).
L85@P3: 指在 25 ± 2 ℃环境下，电芯以 0.2C（1030 mA）恒流放电至 2.50 V。
L86@P3: 2.3 Rated capacity 额定容量
L87@P3: Rated capacity refers to the minimum capacity of the cell, using mAh as unit. Specifically, it refers to the
L88@P3: minimum value of the capacity, which is obtained by discharging a cell via standard discharge method after
L89@P3: standard charge.
L90@P3: 额定容量指的是电芯的最小容量，单位为毫安时（mAh）。具体地说，是指电芯按标准充电方式充电
L91@P3: 后，按标准放电方式放电得到的容量最小值。
L92@P3: 2.4 Typical capacity 典型容量
L93@P3: Typical capacity is the typical value of the cell’s capacity, which is obtained by discharging a cell via
L94@P3: standard discharge method after standard charge, using mAh as unit.
L95@P3: 典型容量指的是电芯容量的典型值，指电芯按标准充电方式充电后，按标准放电方式放电得到的容量
L96@P3: 典型值，单位为毫安时（mAh）。
L97@P3: 2.5 Nominal voltage 标称电压
L98@P3: Nominal voltage of the cell, refers to the platform value of the discharge voltage via standard discharge
L99@P3: method after standard charge. The unit is volt (V).
L100@P3-4: 电芯标称电压，指的是按标准充电方式充电后，按标准放电方式放电电压的平台值，单位为伏特（V）。Document No P/PR03/PB-D-N21700CD-53E-ZZ-SP Version B/00 Page
L101@P4: This spec manual is the enterprise standard of ZhengZhou BAK Battery Co., Ltd. Without authorization, any pirate or
L102@P4: circulation is prohibited.

L104@P4: 2 /19
L105@P4: 2.6 Rated energy 额定能量
L106@P4: Rated energy of the cell is calculated by multiplying the nominal voltage by the rated capacity. The unit is
L107@P4: watt hour (Wh).
L108@P4: 电芯额定能量通过标称电压乘以额定容量计算得出，单位为瓦时（Wh）。
L109@P4: 2.7 Typical energy 典型能量
L110@P4: Typical energy of the cell is calculated by multiplying the nominal voltage by the typical capacity. The unit is
L111@P4: watt hour (Wh).
L112@P4: 电芯典型能量通过标称电压乘以典型容量计算得出，单位为瓦时（Wh）。
L113@P4: 2.8 Limited charging voltage 充电限制电压
L114@P4: Limited charging voltage of the cell, refers to the rated maximum charging voltage of the cell, expressed in
L115@P4: Ucl.
L116@P4: 电芯充电限制电压，指的是电芯的额定最大充电电压，以 Ucl表示。
L117@P4: 2.9 End of discharge voltage 放电终止电压
L118@P4: End of discharge voltage of the cell, refers to the voltage at the end of the standard discharge of the cell,
L119@P4: expressed in Ude.
L120@P4: 电芯放电终止电压，指的是电芯标准放电结束时的电压，以 Ude表示。
L121@P4: 2.10 Upper limited charging voltage 充电上限电压
L122@P4: Upper limited charging voltage of the cell, refers to the highest safe charging voltage that the cell can
L123@P4: withstand, expressed in Uup.
L124@P4: 电芯的充电上限电压，指的是电芯能承受的最高安全充电电压，以 Uup 表示。
L125@P4: 2.11 Discharge cut-off voltage 放电截止电压
L126@P4: Discharge cut-off voltage of the cell, refers to the minimum safe discharge loaded voltage that the cell can
L127@P4: withstand, expressed in Udo.
L128@P4: 电芯的放电截止电压，指的是电芯能承受的安全放电最低负载电压，以 Udo表示。
L129@P4: 2.12 Allowable maximum surface temperature 可允许的最高表面温度
L130@P4: Allowable maximum surface temperature of the cell, refers to the allowable maximum surface temperature of
L131@P4: the cell under normal working conditions, expressed in Tmax.
L132@P4: 电芯可允许最高表面温度，指的是电芯在正常的工作条件下电芯表面可允许的最高温度，以 Tmax表示。

L257@P7: Note (1): Cell’s upper limited charging voltage shall not exceed 4.25 V to prevent any safety events. And cell
L258@P7: performances have negative effect between 4.20 V and 4.25 V. 备注（1）：电芯的充电上限电压值不得超过
L259@P7: 4.25V，以防发生任何安全事件。同时，电芯性能在 4.20 V 到 4.25 V 之间会有负面影响。
L260@P7: Note (2): Cell’s discharge cut-off voltage shall not drop below 2.00 V to prevent any safety events. And cell
L261@P7: performances have negative effect between 2.50 V and 2.00V. 备注（2）：电芯放电截止电压值不得低于 2.00 V，
L262@P7: 以防发生任何安全事件。同时，电芯性能在 2.50 V 和 2.00 V 之间会有负面影响。
L263@P7: Note (3): Charge-discharge current and voltage profile at different temperature range shall be defined by BAK.
L264@P7: 备注（3）：不同温度范围下充放电电流和电压策略请联系比克获取。
L265@P7: Note (4): Cell’s maximum surface temperature during charging shall not exceed 55℃, cell performance and safety
L266@P7: can’t be guaranteed above 55℃. 备注（4）：充电过程中电芯最高表面温度不允许超过 55℃使用，高于 55℃
L267@P7: 电芯性能和安全无法得到保证。
L268@P7: Note (5): Charge shall not be allowed after reaching the temperature limits until cell has cooled down to less than
L269@P7: or equal to 45℃. 备注（5）：达到温度限制后，电芯表面温度需冷却到≤45℃以下，才允许再次充电。
L270@P7: Note (6): Cell’s maximum surface temperature during discharging shall not exceed 70℃, cell performance and
L271@P7: safety can’t be guaranteed above 70℃. 备注（6）：放电过程中电芯最高表面温度不允许超过 70℃使用，高
L272@P7: 于 70℃电芯性能和安全无法得到保证。
L273@P7: Note (7): Discharge shall not be allowed after reaching the temperature limits until cell has cooled down to less
L274@P7: than or equal to 60℃. 备注（7）：达到温度限制后，电芯表面温度需冷却到≤60℃以下，才允许再次放电。
